# ej2-icons

## Setup

To install `ej2-icons`, use the following command

```sh
npm install @syncfusion/ej2-icons
```

## Steps to Add New Icons in the Icons Library

### Prerequisites

1. Download the Metro Studio from [https://www.syncfusion.com/downloads/metrostudio](https://www.syncfusion.com/downloads/metrostudio).

### Add New Icons

1. Check out the repository from [https://github.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library](https://github.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library).
2. Add the new icons at the end of each theme shared by the UX team.

   **Metrop file path:** `resources >> <theme> >> e-icons.metrop`

   Folder structure: [https://github.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library/tree/development/resources](https://github.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library/tree/development/resources)

   > **Note:** Ensure the icon name and font name are in lowercase, separated by `-`. Also ensure the ASCII value is unique for every icon.
3. Open the `e-icons.metrop` file in Syncfusion Metro Studio and click **Create Font** in the bottom-right corner.
4. In the popup that opens, click **Generate Font Icon** at the bottom of the popup.
5. Browse to the specified path and click **Export**.
6. Once the icons are exported, the File Explorer opens at the specified path where the icons were generated.
7. Click **Embed Font in CSS**, copy the `demo.html` and `style.css` files, and replace them in the corresponding theme folder here: [https://gitea.syncfusion.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library/src/branch/development/resources/bootstrap](https://gitea.syncfusion.com/essential-studio/ej2-icons-library/src/branch/development/resources/bootstrap).
8. Ensure that the `title` attribute is added for every icon in the `demo.html` file.
9. Repeat the same steps for all themes.

### Updating the Title for Icons for New Themes

1. Download the `icons-library-title-update-program` project from the Azure DevOps task attachment: [Task #881439](https://dev.azure.com/EssentialStudio/Ej2-Web/_workitems/edit/881439).
2. When newly adding icons for themes, copy and paste the icons library `resources` and `styles` folders into the following project directory: `ConsoleApp\App_Data\html`.
3. Add the newly added theme names to the list in the project's `Program.cs` (as highlighted in the task snippet).
4. Run the project — it will update the title changes.
5. The title-updated files will be available at: `ConsoleApp\bin\Debug\netcoreapp3.1\App_Data\html`.
6. Copy the `styles` and `resources` folders from the above directory and replace them in your local `ej2-icons-library` checkout.
7. Check the diff, ensure the titles are updated properly, and commit the changes.

### Resolve glyf Warnings

Run the following command to resolve glyf warnings:

```sh
py -3 -m pip install fonttools; py -3 tools\fix_glyf_bbox.py
```
